# NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine

> Official website of NVO987, a French cultural and research association dedicated to modern and contemporary visual culture, art history, cultural studies, interdisciplinary research, semantic web technologies, decentralized identity, and digital knowledge infrastructures.

## Main Website

- https://nvo987.fr/ — Official homepage
- https://nvo987.fr/association.html — Association
- https://nvo987.fr/projets.html — Projects
- https://nvo987.fr/publications.html — Publications
- https://nvo987.fr/evenements.html — Events
- https://nvo987.fr/actualites.html — News
- https://nvo987.fr/contact.html — Contact
- https://nvo987.fr/engagements.html — Commitments
- https://nvo987.fr/mentions-legales.html — Legal notice

## Research Infrastructure

- https://identity.nvo987.us — Decentralized Identity (DID)
- https://identity.nvo987.us/.well-known/did.json — DID Document
- https://identity.nvo987.us/.well-known/did-configuration.json — DID Configuration
- https://lab.nvo987.us — Research Laboratory
- https://knowledge.nvo987.us — Knowledge Infrastructure
- https://fediverse.nvo987.us — Fediverse Services
- https://valoriax.nvo987.fr — Valoriax Platform
- https://nexarium.us — NEXARIUM Open Decentralized Web Infrastructure
